        - Key: Tier

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-db-1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-db-3
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  EIP3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
